players.name: Raleigh/Jeffers
players.summary: Ryan Jeffers placed on 10-day IL with a fractured left hamate bone (sustained May 18 vs. Astros). Surgery required; team expects 6-8 week recovery timeline. Alex Jackson called up.

players.name: Bryce Harper
players.summary: Phillies fell 4-1 to the Reds as Chase Burns dominated; Harper went 0-for-3 with a hard comebacker that Burns fielded and threw him out. No injury concerns.

sources.title: Phillies' offense goes quiet in 4-1 loss to Reds - Philadelphia Inquirer

players.name: Luis Arraez
players.summary: Arraez went 2-for-4 in a multi-hit effort, but Giants fell 5-3 to the Diamondbacks as Ketel Marte hit a walk-off 3-run HR in the 9th. Batting around .302 on the season.

sources.title: Giants' Luis Arraez: Multi-hit effort in defeat - CBS Sports

players.name: Bo Bichette
players.summary: Career highlight: hit two home runs in the first two innings (2-run HR in the 1st and 2nd) driving in 4, powering a 5-0 Mets lead. NYM blew it and lost 9-6 to Nationals. Entering game at .219 with 3 HR.

sources.title: Watch Mets' Bo Bichette launch second HR in 2 innings vs. Nationals - Yahoo Sports

players.name: Lindor/McGonigle
players.summary: McGonigle went 1-for-4, singling in the 9th to put the tying run in scoring position, but Tigers fell 4-3 to Guardians (4th straight loss). McGonigle batting .322 with a .904 OPS in his rookie campaign.

sources.title: Guardians survive ninth-inning scare to beat Tigers 4-3 - Washington Post

players.name: Pete Crow-Armstrong
players.summary: PCA singled in the 8th as Cubs fell 5-2 to Brewers. MLB fined him $5,000 (announced May 19) for a profane exchange with a White Sox fan on May 17; suspension was avoided.

sources.title: Cubs' Pete Crow-Armstrong fined $5,000 for fan interaction - Chicago Sun-Times
Pete Crow-Armstrong Officially Avoids Suspension - Bleacher Nation

players.name: Jackson Merrill
players.summary: Padres fell 5-4 to Dodgers in a competitive series game; Merrill went 1-for-4 as San Diego held a late lead but couldn't hold on. Merrill batting .202 through mid-May.

sources.title: Dodgers Win Electric Battle vs. Padres to Even Series - Dodgers Nation

players.name: Teoscar Hernandez
players.summary: Doubled in the 5th inning and scored on a Shohei Ohtani groundout in the Dodgers' 5-4 comeback win over the Padres. Freddie Freeman hit two home runs to power the rally.

sources.title: Dodgers 5-4 Padres (May 19, 2026) Game Recap - ESPN

players.name: Devin Williams
players.summary: Williams was not used as Mets fell 9-6 to Nationals after blowing a 5-0 lead (no save opportunity). Williams has been outstanding: 7 saves and a 6-game consecutive scoreless streak.

sources.title: Mets' Devin Williams finding his groove in 2026 - MLB.com

players.name: Zack Wheeler
players.summary: Wheeler was not scheduled to start Tuesday. Phillies lost 4-1 to Reds (Luzardo started). Wheeler maintains an elite 1.85 ERA through 6 starts on the 2026 season.

sources.title: Reds 4-1 Phillies (May 19, 2026) Box Score - ESPN

players.name: Cole Ragans
players.summary: On 15-day IL (retroactive to May 7) with left elbow impingement (valgus extension overload/VEO). Royals received an encouraging update: minimal IL stay expected after a 3-4 day throwing shutdown.

players.name: Chase Burns
players.summary: Dominant gem: 6 IP, 9 K, 0 BB, 1 ER (Trea Turner solo HR) in Reds' 4-1 win over Phillies. Burns improves to 6-1 with an ERA of 1.83; was hit by a Harper comebacker but stayed in and finished six strong innings.

sources.title: Chase Burns strikes out 9 and flashes All-Star form for Reds - Washington Post

players.name: Nathan Eovaldi
players.summary: Scratched from his scheduled Monday start vs. Arizona with left side tightness. Eovaldi threw a bullpen session and told reporters he feels good, expecting to make his next start Sunday vs. the Astros.

sources.title: Rangers' Nathan Eovaldi scratched due to left side tightness - ESPN

players.name: Emmet Sheehan
players.summary: Rough outing: allowed 4 runs in just 4 innings against Padres, but Dodgers rallied from a 4-1 deficit for a 5-4 win (Freeman homered twice, including a go-ahead shot). Sheehan's ERA rises to 5.26.

players.name: Reid Detmers
players.summary: Pitched 6 solid innings as Angels edged the Athletics 2-1 in dramatic fashion; Zach Neto broke up the A's no-hit bid with a walk-off 2-run HR in the 9th inning to complete the comeback.

sources.title: Athletics vs. Angels (May 19, 2026) Box Score - ESPN
